bundle_commands.document: 按玩家当前所在维度收取通宝后执行当前维度的随机传送。
bundle_commands.head: paid-rtp
body: IF is-in-world? %player:name% minecraft:overworld THEN chain has-currency? %player:name% smp3:tongbao 3 chain run as player %player:name% rtp chain economy take %player:name% smp3:tongbao 3 ELSE chain has-currency? %player:name% smp3:tongbao 5 chain run as player %player:name% rtp chain economy take %player:name% smp3:tongbao 5

bundle_commands.document: 设置家，每人最多两个。
bundle_commands.head: fuji-home-set <home-name home>
body: IF execute if score %player:name% fuji_home_count matches ..1 THEN chain run as player %player:name% home set $home chain scoreboard players add %player:name% fuji_home_count 1 ELSE send-message %player:name% <red>你最多只能设置 2 个家。

bundle_commands.document: 删除家并减少计数。
bundle_commands.head: fuji-home-unset <home-name home>
body: chain run as player %player:name% home unset $home chain scoreboard players remove %player:name% fuji_home_count 1
